'''Tannrel''' was a [[Private/Legends|private]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] that served on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Tannrel's unit was tasked with destroying the [[Sons of Palawa]] who had been infected by [[the Imprisoned One]], and destroyed their village with [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] explosives.<ref name="Mail" />
